description: Lists dated transits to the person's own birth chart: when the moving planets make exact aspects to their natal planets (and to the rising degree and Midheaven when the birth time and place are known), with what astrology traditionally reads into each. Use it for my transits, what's coming up for me, or my year ahead, once the person has given a birth date; for a Sun-sign horoscope use get_horoscope or get_horoscope_period. Give the birth date, and the time, birthplace time zone and coordinates only as the person gives them; never guess a birth time. When they name a town or city instead of coordinates, use find_birthplace first and pass its latitude, longitude and time zone. Pass currentZone, where they live now, so the dates fall on their own clock. By default it covers the next 30 days; give from and to for any window up to 366 days (windows over 92 days keep to Jupiter through Pluto). The window cannot start before the birth date. A retrograde contact's pass number counts the whole loop, including passes outside the window. With mode year-ahead it gives the year's highlights instead: Jupiter and Saturn on the Sun, Moon, Mercury, Venus, Mars and rising degree, Uranus, Neptune and Pluto on the Sun, Moon, Mercury, Venus and Mars, the solar return, a Saturn return, Jupiter and Saturn changing sign (with the house it falls in when the time and place are known) and eclipses near natal planets. If the birth date is under 18, do not frame the lines as romance or attraction. Present each line plainly and confidently as astrology's reading, with its reading-confidence label, never as a guarantee, and never turn a line into health, financial or medical advice.

birthDate.description: The birth date, such as 1990-05-03 (years 1800 to 2199).

currentZone.description: Where the person lives now, such as Asia/Bangkok, so dates fall on their own clock. Without it, dates use the birthplace clock, or UTC if that is missing too, and the answer says which.

from.description: For window: the first day, such as 2026-11-01. Defaults to today.

latitude.description: Optional. The birthplace's latitude; with a birth time it adds the rising degree and Midheaven. Give it with longitude and zone. Nothing is stored.

longitude.description: Optional. The birthplace's longitude, with latitude. Nothing is stored.

mode.description: window (the default): every exact contact between from and to. year-ahead: the year from today, with Jupiter and Saturn, the solar return, a Saturn return, sign changes and eclipses near the chart.

time.description: The birth time on the local clock, only if the person knows it. Never guess it. Needs zone. Without it the Moon, rising degree and Midheaven are left out.

to.description: For window: the last day, at most 366 days after from. Defaults to a 30-day window, from included.

zone.description: The birthplace's time zone, such as Europe/Madrid. Needed with a time or a place.
